about_the_game:
You dashed into the first apartment you could find, trying to escape the sudden downpour—and here’s the result: a slamming door, an unfamiliar interior, and… her. Tall, with dark hair cascading to her shoulders, wearing a tight black dress and a faint smirk. She seems like an ordinary woman, but something in her gaze sends a shiver down your spine.

"So… where to now, little one?"

This apartment isn’t a trap… but you’re not getting out that easily. Is she joking, or does she really not plan to let you go? Or maybe… you won’t even want to leave? After all, there’s Wi-Fi, a fridge full of food, and the hostess is… interesting.

What awaits you?

  • Freedom or comfort? — Will you try to escape through the window or stay for a "cup of tea"?

  • Ambiguous dialogue — Do her words sound like threats… or flirting?

  • Secrets of the apartment — Why is there so much black in the closet?

  • An uncertain ending — How will it all conclude—with an escape, something more risqué… or an unexpected twist?

  • An anime-style visual novel 

"Well? Made up your mind yet… or should I choose for you?"
